items.title: Pay late-filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Betrag innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 27 Jan 2025, posted by a tax authority; under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting = Fri 31 Jan 2025. Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the next day (31 Jan 2025) and ends one month later, on Fri 28 Feb 2025 (§ 188 Abs. 3 BGB). 28 Feb 2025 is a Friday and not a public holiday in NW, so no shift applies (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO).

items.title: File Einspruch against the surcharge assessment
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Same delivery and counting logic as the payment obligation: deemed delivery on Fri 31 Jan 2025 (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO), one-month Einspruch period under § 355 Abs. 1 AO starts 31 Jan 2025 and runs to Fri 28 Feb 2025 (§ 188 Abs. 3 BGB, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB). 28 Feb 2025 is a business day in NW, so the deadline stays there (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO). The Einspruch must reach the Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf in writing or electronically by this date.

warnings: The letter's stated posting/document date (27 Jan 2025) is used as the earliest plausible posting day for the deemed-delivery calculation under § 122 Abs. 2 AO; if the envelope shows a later postmark, both deadlines shift accordingly.

The IBAN printed (DE92 5205 0000 0001 2003 40) is well-formed and matches a German bank, but ownership cannot be verified from the letter alone; use only payment details you can independently confirm belong to Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf.
